scope: Primary-source review of 2025-2026 EEG foundation-model evaluation methods. No data or weights were downloaded and no training was run. Public paper PDFs were read only to verify protocols.

bci_arena_context.publication_note: EEGPT publication remains held for weight-license ambiguity.
current_protocols: New three-seed EEGNet runs only on ds003810 and EEGMAT

novelty_boundary: Cross-subject transfer, within-subject few-shot calibration, reduced-channel evaluation, generic corruption/noise robustness, linear probing, full fine-tuning, LoRA/parameter-efficient tuning, channel adapters, and test-time adaptation under dataset/device shifts are established evaluation axes. BCI Arena should claim a distinctive, operational benchmark package and prespecified decision metrics, not invention of those component methods.

verified_overlap.work: EEG-FM-Compass: Progress, Benchmarking, and Future Directions for EEG Foundation Models (v3; National Science Review, 2026)
verified_protocols: 12 open-source EEG FMs and 8 specialist baselines on 13 datasets spanning 9 paradigms
Cross-subject LOSO or subject-disjoint evaluation; Sleep-EDFx and TUAB use ten subject folds

Within-subject few-shot adaptation with dataset-specific calibration fractions, including 30% of one MI session, 5-10% for P300, 10% for Sleep-EDFx and SEED-VIG, and first-seizure adaptation for CHB-MIT
Full-parameter fine-tuning versus frozen-encoder linear probing
Three seeds, individually tuned hyperparameters, task-appropriate metrics, and leakage-aware rankings that omit downstream datasets disclosed in pretraining
verified_overlap.implication: Do not present cross-subject, few-shot, linear-probe/full-tune comparison, or a pretraining-overlap-aware summary as novel by itself. Compass few-shot uses labeled subsets, but it does not package strictly chronological calibration prefixes with a fixed minute budget and forward-only later-session scoring.

verified_overlap.work: Are EEG Foundation Models Worth It? Comparative Evaluation with Traditional Decoders in Diverse BCI Tasks (ICLR 2026)
verified_protocols: Six decoding protocols: population, per-subject self, per-subject transfer, leave-one-subject-out zero-shot, leave-one-subject-out fine-tune, and post-fine-tune drop on source subjects
Foundation models in frozen linear-probe and fully fine-tuned modes compared with compact neural and classical non-neural decoders
Broad classification and regression task coverage with rigorous statistical testing
verified_overlap.implication: Population, personal, transfer, zero-shot, limited adaptation, and catastrophic-forgetting views already exist. Distinction must come from causal time order, explicit budgets, device-paired data, or operational risk metrics.

verified_overlap.work: A Multi-dimensional Framework for Evaluating Generalization in EEG Foundation Models (CHIL/PMLR 2026)
verified_protocols: LaBraM, CSBrain and CBraMod versus supervised EEG baselines on six datasets
Parameter efficiency via full fine-tuning, LoRA and linear probing
Sample efficiency at fixed total labeled-sample budgets while varying subject diversity and samples per subject
Channel efficiency using structured sparse montages with 1-3 channels per cortical lobe and lobe-restricted frontal, central, or midline configurations
Balanced accuracy, macro-F1 and Cohen's kappa; folds/seeds depend on dataset
verified_overlap.implication: Limited labels, sparse channels, LoRA, and a generic multidimensional scorecard are established. Fixed wall-clock calibration minutes and real paired hardware shifts remain meaningfully different from sample-count and simulated-channel ablations.

verified_overlap.work: A Negative-Control Protocol for Clinical EEG Foundation-Model Benchmarks: Dataset Identity and External-Cohort Stress Testing (arXiv v3, 2026)
verified_protocols: Five frozen EEG encoders on five benchmark tasks plus one external Korean cohort
Subject-disjoint probes where IDs exist; recording-level folds plus an annotated no-overlap sensitivity when IDs are unavailable
Stronger handcrafted comparators, matched fully random initialization, label permutation, raw-signal random features, and scrambled-label adaptation
Dataset-identity probes with in-fold PCA and balanced subsampling
Explicit pretraining-exposure notes and bounded attribution rather than causal or clinical claims
verified_overlap.implication: Random initialization, random features, label permutation, stronger classical features, dataset-ID prediction, and external-cohort stress are established controls. BCI Arena can make them a mandatory Phase-0 gate, but should not market the controls themselves as new.

verified_overlap.work: Channel Adaptation for EEG Foundation Models: A Systematic Benchmark Across Architectures, Tasks, and Training Regimes (arXiv v1, 2026)
verified_protocols: Conv1d projection, spherical-spline interpolation, source-space decomposition, Riemannian re-centering, and native handling
Five models, five tasks, frozen-probe and supervised full fine-tuning, with 10-15 seeds
Architecture-dependent adapter effects and probe-versus-fine-tuning asymmetry
verified_overlap.implication: Channel adapters and adapter sensitivity are established. Intentional unit, reference, channel-order and metadata transformations should be framed as an ingestion-contract/correctness gate, while true paired device data can support a separate robustness track.

verified_overlap.work: Test-Time Adaptation for EEG Foundation Models: A Systematic Study under Real-World Distribution Shifts / NeuroAdapt-Bench (arXiv v3, 2026)
verified_protocols: Tent, SHOT and T3A against no adaptation
Four EEG-FM variants on five datasets with patient-disjoint splits
Subject, cross-dataset/task, and extreme EarEEG modality/device shifts
Online and offline, gradient and optimization-free adaptation; adaptation batch-size, runtime and memory analyses
verified_overlap.implication: Generic test-time adaptation and EarEEG/device-shift evaluation are already covered. A BCI Arena track should focus on paired same-participant, same-label wet/dry acquisition and fixed labeled recalibration budgets rather than claim TTA novelty.

candidate_tracks.name: Prospective chronological drift with a recalibration-minute budget
candidate_tracks.status: Recommended distinctive package; component ideas overlap with few-shot and session-transfer literature
candidate_tracks.hypothesis: A model that looks strong under randomized few-shot selection may require materially more calibration or degrade faster when calibration is restricted to the first causal minutes and testing moves forward in time.
leakage_safe_protocol: Outer split by participant; within the held-out participant preserve recording/session timestamp order.
Train population model only on other participants. Select all preprocessing, optimizer, adapter rank, early stopping and thresholds without future target data.
Expose only a chronological prefix of the target stream at budgets 0, 2, 5 and 10 recorded minutes; report both wall-clock protocol time and retained labeled EEG time.
Calibrate once on the prefix, then freeze and score the remaining current session and every later session in order. Never reshuffle future trials into calibration.
If repeated recalibration is studied, prescribe its trigger and cumulative labeled-minute budget in advance and charge every target label to the budget.
candidate_tracks.training_only_calibration: Fit normalization statistics, probability calibration, thresholds and debounce parameters on population-train/validation data plus the allowed target prefix only. Test labels and later-session data remain inaccessible.
metrics: Balanced accuracy or macro-F1 versus cumulative labeled minutes
Area under the calibration-budget curve
Forward-session performance drop and worst-later-session score
Minutes needed to reach a prespecified performance floor, reported with participants that never reach it
Per-participant paired deltas with bootstrap confidence intervals
candidate_tracks.required_data: Repeated sessions with reliable timestamps/order, stable task labels, participant IDs, and enough trials after each prefix. SHU-style repeated MI or existing multi-session assets are suitable after license and chronology checks.
confounds: Practice/fatigue is entangled with time
Class order may be blocked
Recording gaps inflate wall-clock budget
Offline replay cannot establish interactive closed-loop benefit
candidate_tracks.compute_burden: Moderate: one population model plus 4 target-budget adaptations per fold/model/seed; avoid an unconstrained hyperparameter grid.
candidate_tracks.overlap_and_distinction: Compass evaluates labeled within-subject subsets and ICLR 2026 evaluates LOO fine-tuning. The proposed contribution is a prespecified causal prefix, minute accounting, forward-only scoring, and cumulative recalibration cost.

candidate_tracks.name: Risk-coverage and abstention under a fixed false-activation budget
candidate_tracks.status: Recommended distinctive operational packaging; selective prediction is established generally, but this event-level BCI formulation was not found in the reviewed EEG-FM benchmarks
candidate_tracks.hypothesis: Accuracy ranking will change when systems must abstain and satisfy the same false-command activation budget on explicitly labeled no-control exposure.
leakage_safe_protocol: Use continuous replay with strictly causal filtering, windowing, inference and debounce; no centered windows or zero-phase filtering that sees future samples.
Split participants first and preserve contiguous no-control intervals. Never split overlapping windows across train/validation/test.
Select confidence score, class thresholds, hold time and refractory period only on validation participants/intervals.
Set each system to the same prespecified false activation events/hour target, then freeze the policy before test.
Count event-level triggers after debounce rather than correlated window errors.
candidate_tracks.training_only_calibration: Fit temperature/Platt/isotonic calibration and all decision thresholds on training/validation only. Report a separate uncalibrated sensitivity so calibration quality is not confused with representation quality.
metrics: Command recall and wrong-command rate at fixed false activations/hour
Risk-coverage curve and area under selective-risk curve
Detection latency from allowed command onset to first stable trigger
No-control exposure hours and confidence intervals for the false-activation rate
Balanced accuracy on eligible command windows as a secondary diagnostic
candidate_tracks.required_data: Continuous recordings with explicit command and genuine no-control/idle annotations, enough contiguous no-control exposure to estimate rare event rates, and trustworthy event timing. Cue-gated idle is only a pilot, not open-world unknown intent.
confounds: Always abstaining trivially minimizes false activations
Window overlap understates uncertainty
Prompted idle differs from natural activity
Replay excludes user feedback and closed-loop adaptation
candidate_tracks.compute_burden: Low to moderate after logits exist; the main burden is long, semantically valid no-control exposure rather than GPU time.
candidate_tracks.overlap_and_distinction: The reviewed benchmarks emphasize BCA/AUROC/F1 and adaptation deltas. This package changes the decision question to usable coverage at an identical event-level false-trigger budget.

candidate_tracks.name: Paired real-device shift: wet versus dry or laboratory versus wearable
candidate_tracks.status: Recommended if paired data are available; generic device/TTA shift is established
candidate_tracks.hypothesis: Model rankings and adaptation needs under a genuine acquisition-chain change will differ from rankings under channel subsampling or synthetic noise.
leakage_safe_protocol: Require the same participant and same label semantics in both devices; hold out participants from every train and validation decision.
Train on device A only, evaluate zero-calibration on device B, then adapt using a fixed chronological prefix from B and evaluate on later B trials.
Also report A-to-A, B-to-B and B-to-A where available to separate task difficulty from shift direction.
Use only physically shared electrodes for the primary paired comparison; treat interpolated or reconstructed montages as secondary adapter analyses.
Lock label alignment, channel map, units, reference and sampling conversion before test.
candidate_tracks.training_only_calibration: Fit device-specific normalization or adapters on source training participants and the allowed target prefix only. Do not estimate target-wide covariance from the test recording unless explicitly labeled as transductive TTA.
metrics: Paired cross-device performance drop
Recovery per labeled target minute
Worst-participant drop
Expected calibration error
Latency and memory on the named deployment device
candidate_tracks.required_data: Paired same-participant, same-task wet/dry or lab/wearable recordings with device metadata. A small public paired wearable dataset can support a feasibility benchmark; larger restricted corpora remain future work.
confounds: Device order and fatigue
Different electrode locations or task timing
Reference and unit differences
Session gap versus hardware effect
Too few participants for stable ranking
candidate_tracks.compute_burden: Moderate; paired design improves power, but adaptation budgets multiply runs.
candidate_tracks.overlap_and_distinction: NeuroAdapt-Bench already includes extreme EarEEG shift and TTA. The narrower contribution is paired within-person, same-label acquisition shift with source-only and fixed labeled-target-minute accounting.

candidate_tracks.name: Acquisition-contract metamorphic gate
candidate_tracks.status: Recommended mandatory correctness gate, separate from the robustness leaderboard
candidate_tracks.hypothesis: Some apparent robustness failures are ingestion bugs or undocumented invariance assumptions rather than representation failure.
leakage_safe_protocol: Create paired transformations with known semantics: V-to-uV scaling, channel permutation plus matching metadata permutation, reference conversion, polarity inversion where valid, and resample-then-restore controls.
Define expected invariance or expected rejection for each transform before running models.
Use identical examples before/after transformation; do not retrain to pass this gate.
Add destructive controls where metadata is intentionally not updated to verify the gate detects the mismatch.
candidate_tracks.training_only_calibration: None for the primary gate. Any learned adapter moves the result to a separate robustness analysis and must be trained without test examples.
metrics: Logit/embedding deviation for semantically equivalent inputs
Prediction agreement
Explicit rejection rate for invalid contracts
Pass/fail by prespecified tolerance
candidate_tracks.required_data: Existing held-out examples plus authoritative unit, montage, coordinate and reference metadata.
confounds: Average-reference conversion is not invertible without assumptions
Channel permutation is only equivalent when coordinates/names move too
Amplitude normalization may hide unit bugs
candidate_tracks.overlap_and_distinction: Channel Adaptation 2026 compares learned and physics-based montage mappings. This gate tests software and input-contract correctness, so it should not be scored as evidence that a model handles real hardware shift.

candidate_tracks.name: Attribution and negative-control gate
candidate_tracks.status: Established method; recommended Phase 0 before adding new leaderboards
candidate_tracks.hypothesis: A claimed pretrained-model benefit should disappear under controls that remove pretrained weights or task-label information and should exceed strong non-FM baselines under the same split and tuning budget.
leakage_safe_protocol: Reuse exactly the same participant folds, preprocessing, head capacity and tuning budget for pretrained, random-initialized and no-pretraining/scratch encoders.
Permute labels at the participant or contiguous recording unit appropriate to the task, not independently across overlapping windows.
Include strong classical and compact EEGNet-style baselines with equal validation access.
Add EOG-only or non-EEG-channel controls when those signals exist; never synthesize an EOG control from absent channels.
Decode dataset/device identity as a confound probe and state that success localizes dataset structure, not its cause.
candidate_tracks.training_only_calibration: All probes, PCA, thresholds and baseline choices must be fitted inside training folds. Never perform PCA, normalization or feature selection across held-out participants.
metrics: Pretrained-minus-random paired delta
Pretrained-minus-strong-baseline delta
Permutation null distribution
Dataset/device identity AUROC
Confidence intervals over participants and seeds
candidate_tracks.required_data: Existing benchmark datasets and model architectures; optional EOG channels for the artifact control.
confounds: Random initialization tests architecture plus preprocessing, not every pretraining mechanism
Small seed counts give unstable deltas
EOG may contain genuine task timing as well as artifact
candidate_tracks.compute_burden: Moderate to high if encoders are trained from scratch; frozen random-encoder and classical controls are cheaper and can be the first gate.
candidate_tracks.overlap_and_distinction: The targeted negative-control paper already establishes this logic. BCI Arena's value is consistent enforcement across every headline track, not novelty.

candidate_tracks.name: Pretraining exposure ledger and post-cutoff evaluation
candidate_tracks.status: Audit layer; leakage-aware rankings are established, while honest uncertainty and date-bounded test curation improve evidence quality
candidate_tracks.hypothesis: Rankings will change after separating confirmed exposure, adjacent-distribution exposure, likely clean post-cutoff data and unknown provenance.
leakage_safe_protocol: For every model-dataset pair, record checkpoint release date, declared pretraining corpora, dataset versions/DOIs, subject overlap evidence and confidence status.
Classify exposure as confirmed seen, confirmed absent from disclosed inventory, post-cutoff likely unseen, adjacent distribution, or unknown; never collapse unknown into unseen.
Freeze a post-cutoff test list before inspecting model results.
Report full and exposure-restricted rankings side by side; do not infer memorization from exposure alone.
candidate_tracks.training_only_calibration: Dataset selection and exposure labels must be fixed before test results. Hyperparameters still use only training/validation partitions of each selected dataset.
metrics: Performance by exposure stratum
Rank stability after excluding confirmed seen pairs
Fraction of leaderboard cells with unknown provenance
Sensitivity to alternative conservative exposure rules
candidate_tracks.required_data: Model cards, papers, repository histories, checkpoint dates, dataset release/version records and subject identifiers where available.
confounds: Published inventories may be incomplete
Dataset aliases and derived corpora obscure overlap
Post-cutoff reduces but cannot prove absence from private pretraining
Distribution adjacency can remain even without exact overlap
candidate_tracks.compute_burden: Low additional training cost; high provenance-review burden.
candidate_tracks.overlap_and_distinction: Compass already reports leakage-aware ranks and the negative-control study documents exposure. BCI Arena should formalize evidence states and retain unknowns rather than claim a perfectly clean leaderboard.

candidate_tracks.name: Fair adaptation under fixed label, parameter and compute budgets
candidate_tracks.status: Supporting analysis with substantial literature overlap; not a headline novelty claim
candidate_tracks.hypothesis: Model rankings depend on whether tuning is equalized by labels, trainable parameters, wall-clock compute, or validation trials; a single fixed recipe can unfairly favor an architecture.
leakage_safe_protocol: Use nested participant-disjoint validation for hyperparameter selection.
Compare frozen head, limited-budget full fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning under prespecified label count, trainable-parameter count, optimizer-step and validation-evaluation caps.
Give every model the same number of selection trials or the same fixed candidate set; report both tuned and shared-recipe sensitivities.
Include native channel handling and adapter choices only where architecturally valid.
candidate_tracks.training_only_calibration: All learning-rate, layer-unfreezing, adapter-rank and early-stopping choices are selected in inner training/validation folds. Test participants receive one final evaluation.
metrics: Task score versus trainable parameters
Score versus labeled minutes
Score versus GPU-hours
Peak memory
Rank stability across reasonable tuning budgets
candidate_tracks.required_data: Existing labeled benchmark datasets; full training logs and named hardware.
confounds: Wall-clock comparisons are hardware and implementation dependent
Equal steps are not equal optimization opportunity
Adapter families are architecture dependent
candidate_tracks.compute_burden: High if exhaustive; keep to a prespecified small grid and three seeds, then expand only where rank conclusions are unstable.
candidate_tracks.overlap_and_distinction: PMLR 2026 covers linear probe, LoRA and full fine-tuning; Channel Adaptation 2026 covers adapter-by-architecture interactions. Use this track for fairness and sensitivity reporting, not novelty.

recommended_release_order.content: Attribution gate (T5), exposure ledger (T6), and acquisition-contract gate (T4) on current assets.
recommended_release_order.claim_limit: Pipeline audit and bounded attribution only.

recommended_release_order.content: Chronological calibration-minute curves (T1) and event-level abstention at fixed false activation budget (T2), conditional on valid time order and enough true no-control exposure.
recommended_release_order.claim_limit: Offline prospective-style replay; no closed-loop or clinical-use claim.

recommended_release_order.content: Paired real-device shift (T3) with wet/dry or lab/wearable data and fixed target-label budget.
recommended_release_order.claim_limit: Dataset-specific acquisition robustness; no general device or population guarantee.

publication_language.safe: BCI Arena packages causal time order, explicit calibration cost, event-level false-trigger budgets, paired hardware shifts, and mandatory attribution controls into a reproducible evaluation suite.
avoid: First adapter or test-time adaptation evaluation
Unseen data unless exposure is evidenced; use likely post-cutoff or provenance unknown
